# Authentic Europe PMC fixtures

Downloaded 9 October 2026 from the public REST core endpoint. manifest.json records each URL, fixture byte length and SHA-256. JSON content is unchanged; a final newline was added for text-file storage.

29641633 is the original clinical study; 29940049 is its retraction notice. 28664264 is the original genetic-testing meta-analysis; 29294252 is its numerical correction. 20017220 is the independent COPE guidance publication used for owner reassessment. Fixtures verify canonicalization and identifier binding with mocked model judgments; live consensus proof is separate in deployments/recall-v3-release.json.
